purpose: Compare contraction order and intermediate trace generation with FORM 5.0.0; investigation only, no production algorithm changes.
counting_limits: Generated counts are cumulative emitted monomials before collection, not peak resident terms or memory.
Warm Idenso materialization counts already collected cached recipes; compare cold Idenso generation with FORM generated terms.
Arithmetic leaf counts preserve factorization: Add counts sum and Mul counts multiply, without distributing expressions or entering functions/powers. They are not collected polynomial term counts.

statistics_semantics.generated_terms: Cumulative StoreTerm submissions to the sorting buffer (sources/sort.c:4641); includes terms later combined or cancelled. It is not recursion count or peak resident terms.
statistics_semantics.sorted_terms: Terms remaining in F immediately after trace4 plus .sort.
statistics_semantics.bytes_used: FORM-reported sorted output storage size, not peak process memory.
statistics_semantics.peak_resident_terms: Not measured; neither Generated terms nor Terms in output is a peak-memory counter.

source_strategy.trace4_normal_order: For ordinary chains of length>=10 or gamma5 chains longer than4, choose the lexicographically smallest cyclic/reversed word before recursive reduction (opera.c:746-819).
source_strategy.contraction_priority: Trace4Gen: lengths0/2; adjacent equal objects incl cyclic ends; odd-interior explicit4D Chisholm; special two-interior4D; other even-interior4D; shortest-distance repeated generic objects; all-distinct Trace4no (opera.c:858-1245).
source_strategy.all_distinct: Trick applies the4D three-gamma identity, filters gamma5 parity, contracts epsilon pairs with3-index permutations before4-index permutations, and yields one monomial at a time (opera.c:331-665).
source_strategy.scratch: Trace4 reserves19*n WORD scratch for this trace (opera.c:734), excluding the sorter, parent term, and other FORM state. Count is an allocation bound, not total peak memory.

instrumentation.description: Temporary standalone extraction of v5.0.0 EpfGen, Trick, Trace4no and TRACES definition; same algorithm and int32 WORD, instrumented with counters only. No Generator, Normalizer or sorter. Not a performance benchmark.

order_example.selection: b is the unique pair with odd interior (5 matrices). FORM searches odd contractions before even contractions, so it selects b before a (a has4interior matrices along its shorter cyclic direction).

form.reproduction_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
# FORM5 executable used in the saved run; replace only to reproduce on another host.
form_bin=/nix/store/c2x9lj2l3x99xrdx1ba1a63lxyxq6ji0-form-5.0.0/bin/form
gcc -O2 -Wall -Wextra no_contraction_counts.c -o no_contraction_counts
./no_contraction_counts > no_contraction_counts.reproduced.jsonl
for program in *.frm; do "$form_bin" "$program" > "${program%.frm}.reproduced.log"; done

notes: Counters preserve Symbolica factorization. top_terms is only outer Add arity.

distributed_leaf_count_before_collection recursively sums Add and multiplies Mul arities without expanding, sorting, cancelling, or entering functions/powers. It is a syntactic count, not a final polynomial term count.

cold_events means first run of that case in this process. A cold_kernel event appears only on first initialization of that arity/parity table across all cases. warm_events always runs after that case has completed once.
Instrumented stage durations are diagnostics, not competitive timings. Instrumentation adds counter and shape walks.

FORM generated terms are streamed output terms before final sorting. Idenso collected_leaf_calls are cold recipe insertion calls, and warm materialized_recipe_monomials are already merged cached recipes.
All 24 copied simplifier outputs exactly equal the linked current production output. No production source was edited.

order_reproducer.notation: Tr is an ordinary four-dimensional trace; a,b,c,d are Lorentz indices and p0..p7 distinct slashed vectors. Repeated indices are summed.
order_reproducer.first_difference: Idenso selects the shortest cyclic repeated pair (a, even interior); FORM prioritizes the odd-interior four-dimensional Chisholm contraction (b).
order_reproducer.external_first_difference: Default Idenso Schoonschip leaves trace bodies opaque, so the 12-gamma kernel runs before external metric contraction; FORM contracts these metrics before tracing.

warm_timings.method: Five samples per case, interleaved rotating order after all cases are warmed; shared host pinned to CPU 6, Rust opt-level=2/dev-optim dependencies. Input construction and lazy initialization excluded; output destruction included. External_prepass_included times chain-aware Schoonschip plus simplify_gamma; precontracted times gamma only. Manual identities are applied outside the timed region, so these are equivalent-input diagnostics, not timings of an implemented order-selection change.

hep_validation.method: Exact Atom-valued tensor networks using hep_lib_atom, with exact Minkowski metric registered. Three signed-integer assignments; no symbolic expansion or common normal form imposed.
hep_validation.component_formula: ((index*19 + axis*23 + index*axis*11 + sample*(index + axis*7 + 3) + index*index*(axis+5)) % 19) - 9, sample=0..2, index=0..7, axis=0..3
hep_validation.scope: Checks original, first odd reduction, second odd reduction, external-metric input, chain-aware precontracted input, and both the repeated-pair and odd-first simplified outputs. The large default external-metric simplified output was not HEP-evaluated. Finite exact evaluations support equivalence; FORM also proves original minus the reduced expression equals zero.
